Ask about the build

The product

The trail is still being drawn.

RushTrail Runaway is an endless runner built around quick decisions and a trail that never sits still. Move between lanes, clear logs and rivers, and keep the scenery coming. Every run is a small negotiation between speed and nerve.

Coins collected on the trail feed a wider progression of heroes, worlds, and cosmetics. The game is still in development: the core loop is playable, and the world around it is being polished one piece at a time.

What's inside

Built around the moment.

01

One more run.

A lane-based runner loop built for short sessions: read the trail, choose a line, and stay in motion.

02

A trail with many faces.

Jungle, Desert, City, and Halloween worlds bring their own scenery, hazards, and pace.

03

A roster of runners.

A cast of animal heroes, each with their own look and personality. Unlock them and make the trail yours.

04

Reasons to come back.

Collect coins through each run, open chests, claim daily gifts, and build toward new heroes, worlds, and colors.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

Can I play RushTrail Runaway?

Not yet. The game is in active development and there is no public download or store listing. This page will change when that does.

When will it be released?

There is no public release date yet. We would rather share a date when the game is ready for one.

What platforms is it being built for?

RushTrail Runaway is being built for Android, in portrait.

Will it be free?

Pricing and release details have not been announced.

How can I ask about the game?

Email us with the subject “RushTrail Runaway — development”. We are happy to hear from people who are interested in the trail.
